rewriteNotes.changes: All 750 questions were rewritten to be easier: shorter and clearer wording, context hints added to the question, better-known facts where a fact was very obscure, and answer options that are clearly different from each other. Language questions also now have the correct answer spread across all four positions instead of always being the first option.
rewriteNotes.note: Difficulty labels (easy/medium/hard) are unchanged; the questions are simply more approachable overall. Some subjects were adjusted where a question's fact was changed.

distractorUpdate.method: For questions with a clearly identifiable answer type, distractors are selected from curated same-domain alternatives (for example, rivers against rivers, countries against countries, scripts against scripts). The keyed correct answer text is preserved exactly and its index recalculated.
